_comment:
'**Once per Turn Action** - Create a Soul Shackle token: Your next Runeblade or Shadow action this turn gains go again.'

SHAPE: hero ACTIVATE ('Once per Turn Action' = action-speed, 1 AP, offered by play._add_hero_dsl_activations in the action phase with AP and the card-level per_turn limit; play.py:238-339). activation_cost 0 - the printed ability is free.

CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/player/destination (effect_types.py:1942-2013); defaults give SELF control and subtype-based zone routing from the card-DB template.

'THE NEXT RUNEBLADE OR SHADOW ACTION THIS TURN GAINS GO AGAIN' is GRANT_NEXT_CARD, the play-time one-shot queue (player.dsl_queued_card_mods): consumed in play._pay_costs (play.py:1703-1747), which appends 'Go Again' to the PLAYED card's keywords; the filter specs are evaluated against the card being played (_cost_mod_matches, play.py:625-643). CLASS_IN asks about that card's classes AND talents (condition_types.py:1286-1307 - Runeblade is a class, Shadow a talent, one any-match list covers both); CARD_IS_TYPE checks types+subtypes, and 'Action' is a type. 'This turn' holds because unused entries expire in the end-of-turn cleanup (engine.py:933-934).

amount IS AUTHORED AS 0, DELIBERATELY: the compile-side default is 1 (effect_types.py:4681) and _calculate_resource_cost SUBTRACTS the stored amount from the next matching card's cost (play.py:1447-1451). Omitting it would silently make Chane's next Runeblade/Shadow action cost {r} less - a second, unprinted ability.

PRINTED GOAGAIN - FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED: printed_keywords carries GoAgain. In functionalText the trailing 'Go again' sits INSIDE the same bold span as the grant clause ('gains **go again. Go again**'), so it reads like a parsing artifact of the granted keyword rather than a standalone keyword line - but if the DB really prints it, the engine applies every printed keyword unconditionally and loader.conditional_keywords() cannot express this gate: it strips a printed keyword only from an ability whose conditions include SOURCE_IS_ATTACK granting the keyword to the attacking card itself, and Chane grants go again to a FUTURE ACTION, never to an attack of his own. Authoring that SOURCE_IS_ATTACK shape anyway would be semantically wrong, so it was left out. As modelled the printed keyword is inert today (no code path pays a hero an action point for a carried keyword - heroes never resolve as actions), but a reviewer should decide whether the DB keyword belongs there at all.

PREREQUISITE: create_token calls require_card(token_slug) (effect_keywords.py:266-276) and no json/tokens/soul_shackle.json exists, so activation raises MissingCardImplementation mid-game until the token definition is adopted. A minimal stub (.drafts/soul_shackle.json) is filed alongside this draft; at adoption it belongs in json/tokens/.
